components.text:
Circle: medium circle, infernal chalk.

A witch-type performer opens the road from Sage to Great Sage for the one on the circle, or for herself, on a full-moon night.
They must hold Sage, mastered, and agree by sneaking. Tensura's own price and rules for learning the skill still apply.
Costs rare items, altar power and 100,000 of their base Max EP (a setting of the recipe), spent once the skill is learned. Sage stays.
